what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Serbia and Kosovo in Canada: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 123 asylum seekers from Serbia and Kosovo in Canada, 3.3% of all asylum seekers from Serbia and Kosovo.
Refugees from Serbia and Kosovo, a separate group, live mostly in France, Germany, Switzerland and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Kosovo territory in Serbia with the UCK in 1998 and 1999.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2000 to 2003 and 2008 to 2012.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 188 asylum seekers, and UNHCR reports no figure above zero for 2007.
The figure was at its highest, 274, at the end of 2002.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Canada.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Canada only.
